page.overview:
Who is Jujumaru?

Over time, Jujumaru and his brother became elite assassins for the Land of Calm Seas' daimyō.

Jujumaru is merciless and confident in battle. Unlike his brother, however, he is more responsible and not interested in wasting time.

Jujumaru is a tall man of fair complexion with brown eyes and purple hair. His hair has short bangs while they rest is tied up into two loops at the sides of his head, He wears sleeveless green robes and black pants with long, black armbands

Jujumaru is a highly efficient assassin. His specialty in battle is blood-manipulation. He can set up a field made of his blood to restrain the enemies' movements, and likewise control their enemies if hit by his blood. Alternatively, he can fire his blood as a barrage of powerful needles.
